fields.statement: At 68bf3aa, built rhiza (go build) and ran rhiza run start against the real Rex server in scratch repos, with only claude faked. Review run where check alpha's and the critic's agents exit (panes gone) while beta stays open: the fixer's rex split -b <critic's closed block> failed not found, rex block ls -w <run window> listed beta's live block, and the fixer ran rex split -b <beta's block> in the same window; the whole run made one rex window new and succeeded. Two-step workflow (the cycle-1 failure): step one's panes closed at step end, step two's split of the gone anchor failed not found, rex block ls reported the window not found, and the session opened a new window; the run succeeded. Review run with every agent exiting: each session whose window was gone opened a new window and the run succeeded; no Panes windows were left over.

At 68bf3aa, with the built binary, real Rex and a fake claude, a review run (checks alpha, beta; critic, fixer, verifier) where beta's agent stays open: the critic, the leaf fixer and verifier and the cycle-2 alpha check each ran rex split against a block of the run's one window (the fixer after its anchor's pane closed, via rex block ls, on beta's pane), and none ran rex window new; each fake agent logged a REX_BLOCK in that window. The run succeeded.

At 68bf3aa, with the built binary, real Rex and a fake claude, a review run with a session left open logged exactly one rex window new and five rex splits, all in that window, then rex block close of every pane at the end; rex window ls afterwards showed no leftover run window. The run succeeded.
